solutionStrategy: Use the exclamation and expectation statement as direct emotional evidence.
solutionSteps: Identify the event: Nora sees a surprise party.
Notice Wow as an emotional reaction.
Interpret didn't expect this as evidence of surprise.
Remove boredom and claims about directions or cancellation.
Select A because both clues point to surprise.
